summary: Xu-Froment constants are verified from page images, but Xu and Froment never print K(T), and Hoseinzade's constants must not be copied: KH2O is 100 times too low and the k values silently include the 2.246 fresh-catalyst factor. The main technical risk is the hot-end approach. INL's 871 C from 900 C helium is a 29 K Gibbs-equilibrium assumption with no tube model, while the only measured hardware (JAERI mock-up) ran 102 to 125 K below helium, which at S/C 3 and 30.3 bar means 58 to 64% equilibrium conversion instead of 80% (my calculation). INL uses HTS plus LTS and the library has no LTS Cu/Zn kinetics. The 34.0 MMSCFD gas rate depends on 100% tail-gas recycle and the 5.7 MWe nitrogen unit, so excluding them is inconsistent, and deck slide 25's 43.5 MMSCFD is the wrong case (Case 2). TEV-961 Case 6 detail is missing from the local PDF (it ends at A-59, Case 5); Case 5 gives the full cooling train. Tested helium-side correlations exist in JAERI, Sato and TE1236. Ahn and Lee 2026 gives LCOH US$2.37/kg and net GWP 3.50 kgCO2e/kgH2 for h-SMR on a cradle-to-gate basis, implying US$62.7/tCO2e against gray (my calculation). MEA adds about 50 to 60 MW of heat beyond INL's Selexol balance (my calculation), the largest open item on 206.0 MWth.

conflicts.detail: INL Case 6 has 900 C helium and 871 C process gas (29 K), Ahn 25 K, both without a tube model. JAERI measured 102 to 125 K, HA simulated 97 K.
conflicts.resolution: Keep INL as the base case, label it unvalidated, and add a sensitivity to 800 C.

conflicts.detail: Deck slide 25 uses 43.5 MMSCFD, which is TEV-961 Case 2 (725 C ROT). Case 6 is 34.0 MMSCFD (TEV-961 PDF p17, final_v1_7 Table A1).
conflicts.resolution: Replace with 34.0, and only if recycle stays in the balance.

conflicts.detail: 5.7 MWe is excluded and PSA tail gas is out of boundary, yet 34.0 MMSCFD needs full fuel gas recycle and the cryogenic nitrogen unit (TEV-961 PDF p15). Once-through needs about 48 MMSCFD by my estimate.
conflicts.resolution: Treat recycle, its power and 34.0 MMSCFD as one package.

conflicts.detail: Slide 20 calls 176.8 MWth reformer heat duty, but it is process heat with about 29% preheat in Case 5. It belongs to 13.15 t/h while slide 14 uses 8.988 t/h, which would give 120.8 MW (my calculation).
conflicts.resolution: Relabel and use one hydrogen basis.

conflicts.detail: 210 MWth in deck and final_v1_7, 230 MWth in report_latest and report_revised_31oct. final_v1_7 Table A2 also uses 47% for capture electricity against 39.7%.
conflicts.resolution: Team to fix one rating and one efficiency.

conflicts.detail: HA gives KH2O 1.77e3 and fresh-activity k values with no statement; XF gives 1.77e5 and reference activity. HA K2 exponent -4.063 against -4.036 from Zhang's 1.767e-2.
conflicts.resolution: XF governs. Take K(T) from Zhang Table 1, not HA.

conflicts.detail: Process above helium in HTTR (4.5 vs 4.1 MPa, Sato Table 1) and Yin PDF p8. Helium above process in Ahn PDF p4 and INL Case 5 (1015 psi vs about 440 psi). TEV-961 PDF p12 also prints 9.1 MPa.
conflicts.resolution: Open safety-case choice. Do not cite one source as settled.

conflicts.detail: amine_spec uses 21 bar and 2 mol% CO. INL Case 5 gives 26.8 bar and 0.33% CO after LTS. IEAGHG gives 25.8 bar and 4.6% CO with HTS only.
conflicts.resolution: Use 26 to 27 bar unless 21 bar has a basis; set CO after the shift choice.

conflicts.detail: final_v1_7 Table A1 and amine_spec call 31.7 bar the reformer outlet or exit. In Case 5, 460 psi (31.7 bar) is the gas compressor outlet NG-2 and REFORM-2 outlet is 439 psi, 30.3 bar. Case 6 not available.
conflicts.resolution: Use about 30.3 bar and note it comes from Case 5.

conflicts.detail: Tubes 37 (JAERI PDF p93) vs 30 (Sato, HA). Hastelloy XR vs Incoloy 800H. Length 6.37 m, 6.54 m, 6.0 m catalyst. Design H2 122.4, 120, 110 Nm3/h. Particle 5 mm vs fitted 1.2 cm.
HA compares against design specifications (923 K, 873 K), while the mock-up measured He out 883 to 905 K and product gas 824 to 838 K on the whole-exchanger basis.
conflicts.resolution: Cite HA as a fit to design values, not to test data.

conflicts.detail: INL has 3 psi (0.2 bar) per stage. Mock-up measured 0.121 MPa over about 6 m (Yin Table 2). XF simulation shows about 3.3 bar over 12 m by eye.
conflicts.resolution: Treat the INL value as a placeholder and calculate with Ergun.

decisions.question: Which shift arrangement does the project adopt?
decisions.why: CO2 to capture changes by about 17% and absorber CO by a factor of 10 or more (my calculation). All INL numbers assume both beds, and the deck only says WGS.
decisions.default: HTS plus LTS as INL, inlets 335 and 191 C, 10 K approach to equilibrium.

decisions.question: Is PSA tail-gas recycle with nitrogen rejection part of the mass balance?
decisions.why: Gas rate is 34.0 MMSCFD with recycle against about 48 MMSCFD once-through (my estimate), and the 5.7 MWe load follows the choice.
decisions.default: Keep recycle in the balance, count 17.3 MWe, and state that the external PSA returns tail gas.
options: Recycle in the balance with 17.3 MWe
Once-through with tail gas exported and its emissions accounted

decisions.question: What reformer exit temperature is reported as the base case?
decisions.why: 871 C has no tested support. Conversion at the demonstrated approach is 58 to 64% rather than 80% (my calculation).
decisions.default: Base 871 C, disclosed as an INL equilibrium assumption, with sensitivities at 825 and 800 C.
options: Keep 871 C with disclosure and sensitivity
Derate the base case to 825 or 800 C

decisions.question: Where does MEA reboiler heat come from?
decisions.why: MEA needs 50 to 60 MW more than INL's Selexol balance (my calculation), and little syngas heat is hot enough for a reboiler.
decisions.default: Report it as an extra duty on top of 206.0 MWth until heat integration is done.

decisions.question: Which reformer tube concept is used?
decisions.why: A JAERI bayonet recovers syngas heat inside the tube, while INL raises 69.3 MW of steam downstream in Case 5, so duty and steam balance depend on it.
decisions.default: Stay with the INL arrangement because the heat numbers depend on it, and cite the finned bayonet as an option.
options: INL straight tube with waste heat boiler

decisions.question: What is the helium to process pressure relationship?
decisions.why: It sets tube differential and leak direction. INL Case 5 implies about 4 MPa, while tested hardware had about 0.4 MPa.
decisions.default: Keep the differential near the tested 0.4 MPa and leave the sign to the safety case.

decisions.question: If a tube model is built, which kinetic set is used?
decisions.why: Activity alone is a factor of 2.246, and HA's constants differ further.
decisions.default: XF Table 6, KH2O 1.77e5, activity 1.0, K(T) from Zhang Table 1. Fit one activity factor to JAERI A-2 and hold back A-3 and A-4.
options: XF reference activity with one fitted factor

gaps: TEV-961 Case 6 calculator block, flowsheets and Appendix G stream file are missing from the local PDF, which ends at A-59 (Case 5). Case 6 conversion, exit pressure, raw syngas and condensate are not verified.
No LTS Cu/Zn kinetic source in the library.
Chinchen Part III kinetics (cited at 129.4 kJ/mol) is not in the library.
Hou and Hughes 2001, the origin of K(T), is not in the library, so K(T) is second-hand.
No measured EVA outlet tables; Singh 1984 Nucl. Eng. Des. 78:179 is not in the library.
JAERI-Tech 2003-046, 2003-034 and Ohashi 2004 are not in the library, so mock-up rate constants, bed void and bed density are not verified. Yin and Sato do not print k0 or E.
JAERI thermocouple elevations are not verified; JAERI PDF p39 to p92 and appendices B to E were not reviewed in detail.
No effectiveness factor for any helium reformer catalyst, and no axial composition measurement.
Only one measured process pressure drop and no profile.
No water saturation data or Antoine or IAPWS coefficients in the library. Use IAPWS-IF97 or NIST, outside the library.
No syngas cooler U, area or materials, and no process condensate chemistry or treatment design in any source.
Ahn Tables S2 and S3 are not in the library, so HTGR cost allocation and CO2 T&S treatment are not verified. No tube creep data at 870 C and about 4 MPa differential.
